questions.question: 6. The pick up value of relay is 7.5 A and fault current in relay coil is 30 A. Its plug setting multiplier is-

explanations.b: Correct. Plug Setting Multiplier (PSM) = Fault current / Pickup current = 30 / 7.5 = 4.

questions.question: 8. In merz-price protection, the CT secondary of delta - star transformer is connected in-

explanations.a: Correct. For a delta-star power transformer, CTs on delta side are connected in star, and CTs on star side are connected in delta to compensate for 30° phase shift.

questions.question: 9. The number of pilot wires required for protecting 3-phase transmission line using transley system of protection is-

explanations.d: Correct. Translay (TranSLAY) scheme uses 2 pilot wires for differential protection of 3-phase lines.

questions.question: 10. The least expensive overcurrent protection for LV system is-

explanations.a: Incorrect. Isolators are not overcurrent protection devices.
explanations.b: Correct. Fuse is the least expensive overcurrent protection device for low voltage systems.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Oil circuit breakers are more expensive.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Air circuit breakers are more expensive than fuses.
